title: Anon-Stars!
tagline: Anonymous On-Chain Linked-In For Anonymous Hiring and Contributing - Endorse Peers, and Collect/Show-Off Competency Sismos and POAPs
description: Anon-Stars is an on-chain anonymous linked-in for anonymous networking, endorsing reputable peers, and displaying competency Sismos and POAPs.  Hiring of anonymous employees and contractors should be more commonplace in this industry. The crypto ethos is anonymous co-working we need to keep that spirit alive!
how_its_made: I used the hardhat-starter kit from chainlink to get my hardhat enviroment up, I wrote the contract that stores all info and dictates logic in solidity, I used rainbow-kit to initialize a next.js project, rainbow kits wallet connnect, then used tailwind for styling, the contract is deployed on polygon mumbai. I am using wagmi hooks to read the contract and write to the contract.
